item.title: Somalia: the situation
item.description:
Federal forces have relaunched the previously failed Banooda operation, moving a major troop convoy while the defence minister reported killing 285 al-Shabaab fighters, including several commanders, in Bay, Shabelle and Hiiraan. The United States conducted airstrikes on three al-Shabaab sites, and Uganda’s president met Somalia’s president to strengthen security cooperation, with the Ugandan army chief visiting Somali troops as Uganda withdraws from Barawe. Climate shocks and insecurity are driving displacement, with over 18,000 people displaced by fighting in Southwest State as flood threats loom, and the UN warns that unrest in Ethiopia could weaken African Union security operations. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
